# Examples cookbook

Every example below is a runnable PHP file under `examples/`. `tools/run-examples.php` executes them on
both backends (FFI and the native extension) as part of the gate, so they cannot drift from the code.
Examples for FFI-only surfaces (optimize, dense/sparse linear algebra, I/O, csgraph, MDP) skip on the extension.
